thread:
Priya (Accounts Payable): Incoming invoice from HelixML (INV-3327) for $12,400 — Coupa rejected: no PO and bill-to doesn't match our vendor file. PDF: https://drive.redwood.internal/drive/4Xk8/inv-3327.pdf

invoices-bot: Routing alert: approver group for GL 8002 inactive (approval-service v2.2.0)

Maya (Finance): This is for the inference optimization engagement. Contract references PO-6790 but that PO is CLOSED. Could be why auto-match failed.

Leo (Procurement): Confirmed: PO-6790 exists, status CLOSED (end 2025-12-31). Closed POs don't accept new invoices automatically.

Tara (Vendor Ops): I'll ask HelixML to resend a corrected invoice with PO-6790 on the header and exact Bill-To "Redwood Inference - Corp". Provide them our invoice template.

Priya (Accounts Payable): If vendor reissues with PO and correct bill-to, we can auto-process. If not, we have AP ticket AP-9999 ready for manual retro approval.

Maya (Finance): Vendor-first is preferred. @Tara send the template and ask them to reference INV-3327 in the subject. If they can't, escalate to manual approval.

Leo (Procurement): I'll request a short PO reopen for 30 days as backup and ping Marcus for approval.

Priya (Accounts Payable): Noted — holding payment until corrected invoice or reopen approved. Will update AP-9999 when either happens.

Tara (Vendor Ops): HelixML replied: they can reissue but asked whether PO-6790 can be used even though it's closed. I told them yes, put PO-6790 on the invoice and match Bill-To.

Maya (Finance): Great. Thank you everyone — recap actions: (1) @Tara get reissued invoice with PO-6790 + correct Bill-To, (2) @Leo submit PO reopen as fallback, (3) @Priya watch AP-9999 and expedite on receipt.
